_note: Name-facts for Marshall Islands (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region

en: An atoll whose land lies only a few metres above the sea.
The atoll is a ring of some sixty islets around a lagoon.
Its one road, running along the atoll, is about 50 km long.
it: Un atollo le cui terre sono solo pochi metri sopra il livello del mare.
L’atollo è un anello di una sessantina di isolotti intorno a una laguna.
La sua unica strada, che corre lungo l’atollo, è lunga circa 50 km.
de: Ein Atoll, dessen Land nur wenige Meter über dem Meer liegt.
Das Atoll ist ein Ring aus etwa sechzig Inselchen um eine Lagune.
Seine einzige Straße, die am Atoll entlangführt, ist etwa 50 km lang.
